$comment: Written against the JSON Schema draft 2020-12 vocabulary. No remote dialect URI is declared, so validation stays offline; supply the dialect in the validator.
title: RevivePay Cleanup Inventory
description: Reviewed cleanup candidates and their preservation evidence. Machine-readable companion to docs/release/cleanup-inventory.md; scripts/cleanup_inventory.py is the executable authority for the same contract.

candidate.description: Repository path or fully qualified symbol under review.

references_searched.description: One entry per searched reference class. Every class in the reference-class enum must be present before a candidate can be eligible for removal review (Requirements 2.2, 2.3).

public_contract_status.description: Public HTTP contract relationship. UNKNOWN retains the candidate (Requirements 2.3, 2.4).

protected_capability_status.description: Protected Capability relationship. UNKNOWN retains the candidate (Requirements 2.3, 2.4, 2.6).

test_coverage.description: Test identities that exercise the candidate's behavior (Requirements 2.1, 2.5).

dependency_path_scopes_checked.description: Supported paths proven clear for a DEPENDENCY candidate. All four scopes are required before a dependency is eligible (Requirement 2.7).

removal_justification.description: Reviewer reasons for the proposed removal. NAVIGATION_NOT_EXPOSED alone retains the candidate (Requirement 2.6).

proposed_disposition.description: Reviewer proposal. Validation derives the real classification from the recorded evidence and reports a conflict when the proposal is unsupported (Requirement 2.1).

reviewer.description: Identity of the reviewer who examined the evidence (Requirement 2.1).

reviewed_at.description: ISO 8601 date or timestamp of the review (Requirement 2.1).

evidence_gaps.description: Anything the reviewer could not establish. A non-empty list retains the candidate and is recorded as incomplete cleanup evidence (Requirement 2.4).

query.description: The search actually performed, recorded so the review can be repeated.

result.description: Search outcome. FOUND, UNREADABLE, and INCONCLUSIVE each retain the candidate; only NONE_FOUND supports eligibility (Requirements 2.2, 2.4).

locations.description: Where the reference was found. A NONE_FOUND result with locations is conflicting evidence.
